# GAR publishes an article by Jeffery Commission and Hannah Howlett on enforcement of investor-state awards


- International arbitration


April 29, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Global Arbitration Review* publishes a *[Burford Quarterly](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/)*[article](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/2025-issue-2/enforcement-of-investor-state-arbitration-awards/) by[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jeffery-commission/) and[Hannah Howlett](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/hannah-howlett/) on how arbitration awards often face unique enforcement challenges, examining empirical data on enforcement outcomes and the role legal finance plays in helping claimants enforce and monetize awards.


[Read the full article here.](https://globalarbitrationreview.com/article/compliance-investor-state-awards-testing-the-datasets)
